Qatar Notice Period Calculator

Enter your wage, who ended the contract and how much notice was served to see the notice period and the pay in lieu for the days not served.

Prepared and reviewed by the Mustahaqati team · Last updated: 2026-11-03

Work out your notice and pay in lieu

Pay in lieu uses basic pay since the 2020 amendment.

Notice rules in Qatar

ItemRule
Notice periodOne month in the first two years of service, two months after (Article 49 since 2020)
Who must give itBoth sides, for every pay basis; the contract may set a longer period
Pay in lieuBasic wage for the notice period or the part not served
During noticeFull pay for those who keep working; Qataris may take reasonable time off to look for work (Article 50)
ProbationUp to 6 months: employer one month's notice; a worker moving to another employer one month; a worker leaving Qatar the agreed period, up to two months
Leaving without noticePay in lieu; an expatriate may be barred from a work permit for a year; dues are paid within 7 days

Example: Basic salary QAR 6,000 and 3 years of service: two months' notice. If the employer ends the contract immediately, pay in lieu is QAR 12,000. If the worker resigns and leaves after one of the two months, the worker owes QAR 6,000.

Pay in lieu is separate from your end-of-service gratuity; work that out with the Qatar end-of-service calculator, and overtime with the overtime calculator. Prefer Arabic? Use the Arabic version.

Frequently asked questions

What is the notice period in Qatar?

One month if service is two years or less, and two months if it is longer, under Article 49 as amended by Law 18 of 2020; it is the same for worker and employer.

Is pay in lieu of notice in Qatar based on basic or gross salary?

On basic salary for the notice period or the part not served, under the 2020 text.

What if I resign without notice in Qatar?

You owe the employer pay in lieu for the notice not served, and an expatriate who does not comply may be barred from a work permit for a year.

What notice applies during probation in Qatar?

The employer gives one month for unsuitability; a worker moving to another employer in Qatar gives one month, and a worker leaving Qatar the agreed period, up to two months.

Did the 2026 law change notice in Qatar?

No. Law 9 of 2026 amended the non-compete, disputes and strike articles, not the notice articles.
